hero-background.template:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: website hero background
Primary request: abstract futuristic gradient atmosphere with layered geometric light planes and subtle glass depth
Mood keywords: clean, futuristic, elegant, premium
Color bias: deep navy and indigo base (#040b22 #081834 #0a1d43) with cyan accents (#7dd3fc #38bdf8)
Lighting style: soft volumetric glow, controlled bloom, no clipping
Composition: wide cinematic framing with 45% negative space for headline text
Subject constraints: no noisy background, no clutter, no text, no logos, no watermark
Aspect ratio: {{ratio}}
